newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius insurance firm interim profit up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius insurance firm interim profit up 22 pct.

text.p: Mauritian insurance company Swan on Friday posted a 22 percent increase in pre-tax profit to 19.5 million rupees ($932,000) for the half year ending 30 June 1996 versus the same period last year.

Company officials said Swan's profit after tax for the six months period went up by 5.0 percent to 14.3 million rupees while profit attributable to the group was 7 percent higher to 14.1 million rupees as compared to the same period in 1995.
